title: Louder Generator
description: Increments the volume of the Create: Power Grid generator.
body:
This simple resource packs only increments the volume of the generator from Create: Power Grid.

There are three versions of the pack with differents volumes:
- Voulme 1
- Volume 2
- Volume 3

This resource pack uses the .ogg file taken from [the original mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/power-grid/versions), i only amplified the sound. All credits to the original creators that released this fantastic mod!
